parts:
Hello!

I am hoping someone may be able to help me out with this. I am looking to compare detection probability among two of my study regions (eg. Detectability was 40% higher in Region 2).

However, both my regions have slightly different levels of survey effort, site visits, number of sites and surveyor experience. To make detection in Region 1 and 2 comparable, I must correct for these 4 factors.

My thoughts so far...
1. Create a model with: Region + Survey Effort + Site Visits + Number of Sites + Surveyor Experience
2. Solve for Regional Detection Probability when all other variables are set to their mean value. 

How would I go about doing this?

Sean
